title: HTTP /design/read serves the versioned aggregate to the operator
description:
SPIDR child of task-8a6d6660c31c4e119f962d13e6f1505d, spun from task-f3409f9a1f3a4925a73974ea371098e5 (architect-2e480458, 2026-09-05) because child 3's DoD requires POST `/design/read` and that route does not exist.

OBJECTIVE: the operator (and the later Design tab) can POST `/design/read` against a real daemon and get the versioned design aggregate child 1 already stores.

DELIVERABLE: handleDesignReadRequest at `/design/read`, composed as an optional listener port the same way document-dossier-read is, calling readDesignRevision. JSON_ROUTES + POST guard + dispatch. Exact-key body `{goalRef}` or `{goalRef, version}`; projectId from the principal.

NOT IN SCOPE: MCP (task-7f9f20c7), design.submit roster (task-06ac0da1), Design tab / live decoder / proxy pin (sibling UI row), approval card, e2e.

MEASURED: grep handleDesign|/design/read in apps/daemon/src = 0. Child 1 landed readDesignRevision (design-store.ts:189). 06ac0da1 publishes MCP command/query, not HTTP. document-dossier-read.ts is the copy shape.

VERIFICATION: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` plus `pnpm typecheck`.
definitionOfDone: POST `/design/read` is a JSON_ROUTES member with a POST-only guard and a dispatch branch. An unconfigured daemon (no design port) refuses LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE (or the existing UNAVAILABLE pattern for optional reads) with a stable code AND layer, and writes nothing.

The handler authenticates first, then exact-key decodes the body as `{goalRef}` or `{goalRef, version}`. Extra key, missing goalRef, non-string goalRef, or payload-supplied projectId is REFUSED at the listener with a stable code AND layer. projectId is taken from the authenticated principal.

A well-formed operator read of a stored revision returns the record plus the versions list from readDesignRevision. DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT is forwarded with code AND layer. Assert both against a real file-backed store.

UNCONSUMED_SERVED_ROUTES in http-listener-read-dispatch.test.ts names `/design/read` with a reason (no browser consumer yet). UNPROXIED_SERVED_PATHS stays empty only if the proxy pin lands in the same commit; otherwise `/design/read` is recorded there. Do not leave a silent gap.
Gates quoted WITH `Test Files N passed`: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`. A leg with no count line RAN NOTHING.
taskRails: Call readDesignRevision from apps/daemon/src/design/design-store.ts. Do not reimplement the aggregate.
projectId comes from the authenticated principal, never the payload. A payload that carries projectId is an unknown key and is REFUSED.
http-listener-read-dispatch.ts is already 539 lines (over 400). Add the route; do not reformat or split the file in this row.
FEATURES ONLY. No MCP work (that is task-7f9f20c7). No UI (that is the Design-tab sibling).
